title: Detecting Hostile Posts using Relational Graph Convolutional Network
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of detecting hostile posts (hate speech, fake news, etc.) in Hindi. While it mentions that these posts sometimes target religious beliefs and analyzes the model's attention to words like 'Hindu' and 'Muslim', the core of the work is a classification task based on a competition dataset, not an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics as defined in the instructions.
